name: Soya Keema Breakfast Lettuce-Free Wrap
steps: Cover soy granules with boiling water for 8–10 minutes. Drain, rinse and squeeze firmly.
Heat oil in a skillet. Add cumin and onion; cook until softened.
Add tomato, capsicum, ginger and spices. Cook 3–4 minutes.
Stir in soy granules with 2 tbsp water. Cook 5 minutes until flavours combine and mixture is fairly dry.
Spoon into warm rotis, add lemon and coriander, then roll tightly.
note: Contains soy and wheat. Check the soy granules label for protein content; values vary by brand.
